title: I’m making a turn-based tactics + roguelite deck builder, where every room is a puzzle and every action is a card.
author: pikush
selftext:
hey! like the title says, VAULT RAIDERS blends two of my favorite genres into one delicious stew. I’ve been working on the game for several months. it’s been a ton of fun to build and play. 

  
i‘ve worked super hard not just on the game feel, but the room and card art aesthetics. for a while, all my card art looked like AI slop, but I finally had a breakthrough when I figured out tighter art direction and had Claude drive codex, vs trying to prompt codex myself  

  
just put a free demo on Steam if you’d like to check it out! would love to hear what this community thinks. and if anyone wants to discuss art and 3D model pipelines, let’s talk! 

[https://store.steampowered.com/app/5255890/Vault\_Raiders/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5255890/Vault_Raiders/)

comments.author: jmorais17
comments.body: Did codex create the models through blender or was it another system? Looks promising!

replies.author: pikush
replies.body: Thanks! For the 3D models, I concept through Claude and Codex, build with Tripo (I prefer it to Meshy after some side-by-side tests) then clean up in Blender. BUT - I built all my robotic enemies directly in Blender because it created a nice clean look.

comments.author: LiquidZebra
comments.body:
I like the telegraphed damage numbers, but -37 from 2 enemies in a single turn? In a game where your damage card does 8? Do they get 3 actions?

Also, the puzzle tacticals (with only one way to win) are really off putting to many  tactical players, they prefer more agency.

replies.author: pikush
replies.body:
Yeah, it’s a huge enemy damage turn! This gif is actually from a post I’m writing for tomorrow, based on a community playtester who ran into this situation and wasn’t sure what’s to do. The post outlines how to turn a losing room into a win, allowing you to collect a card and potentially make it to a healing site. 

And rooms are not restrictive in how you win! There are tons of synergies and viable solutions based on what cards and artifacts you collect! You can take out enemies with huge single shots, unload with automatic fire, destroy cover and enemies with explosive, or punish enemy attacks with deflector shields — to name just a few options. ☺️

replies.author: LiquidZebra
replies.body: Interesting, overall looks polished. Do you have free move cards? It feels weird for me to see a move cost 1 for 3 squares. Is this a 10x10 or 9x9 map?

replies.author: pikush
replies.body: 9x9. There are free move cards, as well as move cards that increase damage, boost shield, or provide other benefits. These starter moves can also be upgraded to 5 tiles. And the second class, the Ghost, has a base move of 4.
